versionNotes: bankroll v0.0.4 (current, 2026-05-19) - Tier 1 post-cleanup §10.B Liability-aware NAV (top-level cohort still v4; bankroll-only upgrade):
- bankroll_pool: open_exposure dynamic_field tracks live max-liability
(SUM of cap.max_single_payout across in-flight rounds). collect_bet
reserves; pay_winner / refund_bet release. UpgradeCap-compatible
in-place upgrade (no struct change).
- bankroll_pool: utilization cap check now compares cumulative
reservation (existing open_exposure + new bet's max_payout) against
pool.balance × cap_bps, tighter than v0.0.3's per-bet-only precondition.
- bankroll_pool: new OpenExposureSnapshot event emitted per collect/pay/
refund. Indexer writes one bankroll_event row per snapshot with
event_type='open_exposure_snapshot' and open_exposure_after pre-
populated (no reconciler dependency). Migration 006 adds the column.
- risk-metrics.active_exposure_raw now reads chain-authoritative
open_exposure (latest snapshot row), replacing v0.0.3's 'pending_resolve
count' proxy. Frontend label upgraded to 'Open exposure (max liability)'.
- Game contracts unchanged: scratchcard/numbermatch/mines/wheel already
pass GameCap to collect_bet, so the new reservation unit is read
internally from cap.max_single_payout. Crash excluded (game shut down
indefinitely, no relaunch date).
bankroll v0.0.3 (2026-05-18) - Tier 1.0 spike finding 5.3 fix (top-level cohort still v4; this entry covers a bankroll-only upgrade, not a cross-game cohort bump):
- bankroll_pool: seed_pool_shares (idempotent, admin-only) locks pre-existing
pool.balance into total_shares so the first public LP cannot absorb the
unshared seed via the total_shares==0 fast-path.
- bankroll_pool: set_utilization_cap + collect_bet advisory check (per-GameCap
max_single_payout vs cap_bps of pool.balance). cap_bps==0 (default) disables.
- bankroll_pool: utilization_cap_bps stored as sui::dynamic_field on pool.id
so BankrollPool struct layout is unchanged -> UpgradeCap 'compatible' policy
in-place upgrade safe. Live BankrollPool object + accrued balance preserved.
- Live BankrollPool seed locked 2026-05-18 (PoolSharesSeeded event). After
seed: share_price_scaled ~= 1e9 (1.0 pps). Active game PnL continues to
accrue into pps as before.
v4 (current cohort; bankroll v0.0.2 superseded by v0.0.3 above, 2026-04-24 late) - post-review hardening:
- lottery: obligated_amount field tracks unclaimed winner liability
so sweep_unclaimed_to_bankroll cannot accidentally take rollover
funds destined for the next round (H2 fix)
- lottery: SWEEP_GRACE_MS=1h between claim deadline and earliest sweep
closes the same-block claim/sweep race (H4 fix)
- lottery: RoundSettled event now emits base_rollover + obligated_amount
for proper accounting reconciliation (C1 fix)
- bankroll_pool: pause check removed from pay_winner / refund_bet
so legitimate winner payouts cannot be frozen during ops emergency
(H3 fix). Pause still gates collect_bet (new exposure).
- bankroll_pool was UPGRADED in-place via UpgradeCap (function body
changes only), so BankrollPool object + 100K NUSDC seed remain.
- lottery was FRESH-PUBLISHED (struct field added), so v3 lottery is
deprecated; new GameCap issued from same bankroll for v4 registry.
v3 (deprecated, 2026-04-24 late) - 5-of-32 -> 5-of-25 recalibration:
- Lottery range C(32,5)=201,376 -> C(25,5)=53,130, ~3.8x jackpot freq
- Tier payout BPS unchanged (60/25/15 within 70% prize pool)
v2 (deprecated, 2026-04-24 18:xx UTC) - post-audit hardening:
- treasury_deposit GameCap-gated (closes LP inflation)
- LPToken soulbound, owner field removed
- emit_game_result uses cap.game_id (no spoof)
- session_id: vector<u8> (widened from ID)
- provide_liquidity MIN_LP_DEPOSIT=10 NUSDC + virtual-offset share math
- refund_bet, admin-mutation events added
- close/draw time sanity checks in create_round
- LotteryRegistry.game_cap installed at launch
v1 (deprecated, 2026-04-24 AM) - contained LP inflation vector; do not use.
